title: EBS CSI images pulled from k8s.gcr.io must move to registry.k8s.io

detection.reason: read from the image TAG of the ebs-csi-controller / ebs-csi-node workloads — a digest-pinned image (@sha256:…) or a mirror that renames the tag is not resolved and reads clean

quote: If you are using `k8s.gcr.io` you MUST [move to `registry.k8s.io`]
remediation: Repoint every EBS CSI container image (the driver and its csi-* sidecars and livenessprobe) that still pulls from k8s.gcr.io to registry.k8s.io, public.ecr.aws or the EKS ECR registry. k8s.gcr.io is frozen: tags newer than its freeze do not exist there, so an upgrade that only bumps tags fails to pull.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy,ds -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name | test("^ebs-csi-(controller|node(-.+)?)$")) | .metadata.namespace as $n | .metadata.name as $w | .spec.template.spec.containers[] | select(.image | test("^k8s\\.gcr\\.io/")) | "\($n)/\($w): \(.name) \(.image)"'  # each printed container still pulls from the frozen k8s.gcr.io registry
coversNotes: URGENT (1.17.0): Issues related to k8s.gcr.io will no longer be accepted. public.ecr.aws and
